🔒 Account Security

Enter your app login PIN (the same one you use as Admin to open this app) to edit these security settings.
One Admin PIN for Everything
This panel now unlocks with your app login PIN — no separate PIN to remember. To change it, go to Home → Users, tap the Admin user's ✏️ Set Custom PIN button, and enter your new PIN there.
🆘 PIN Recovery Setup
Set this up now, while you still have access — if you ever forget your Admin PIN, you'll be able to reset it yourself on the login screen using just your year of birth. Simple, and nothing to forget. (For security, this box always shows blank when you reopen this screen — that does NOT mean it wasn't saved.)
🔒 PIN Lock
When ON (default), the app always asks for your PIN before opening — recommended. When OFF, the app opens straight to Home for anyone who picks up this phone, no PIN asked at all. Only turn this off if you're the sole user of this phone and no staff/Salesman accounts exist.
